decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core dairy range and costs little to keep, so despite no website mention since 2019 the option is still worth holding.

The flagship evening cheese was a deliberate strategic bet, and with no negative signal so far it remains a cheap option within the cheese range, though its absence from the website lately adds some doubt.
The spicy cheese line can be pruned variant by variant rather than abandoned entirely, so the line is kept while weak variants are trimmed.

The mild creamy soft cheese rounds out the soft-cheese range with broad appeal and low carrying cost, so it is kept, although after four years without visible evidence of success its value is largely resolved.

The niche washed-rind soft cheese has shown no evidence of value after four years, so its uncertainty has resolved unfavourably and the resources are better redeployed to the core business and new development.
